column1: # What this window asks of the line when it is a caller itself: the
# kind of ask, then a line of its head. `stream` opens a room's line,
# `post` joins, leaves and sends. {path} is the room's path, {name} the
# word a page names itself under, {peer} what this window calls itself,
# {speak} the protocol, {host} where the line is, {cookie} who it is to
# the line, {length} how long what it posts is.
